name: Start Campus SINES DC / Sines 4.0 - SIN01 (NEST)
notes: Flagship hyperscale campus in ZILS Sines Industrial and Logistics Zone, Setubal district. Official Start Campus page cites 1.2 GW total campus secured capacity and 37.5 MW live first facility (SIN01); phase-1 construction began April 2022. DCD/ECO confirm SIN01 first building inaugurated; Nscale-Microsoft deployment of ~12,600 NVIDIA GB300 GPUs at SIN01 from Q1 2026 (TechCrunch). Campus design 1.2 GW; live 37.5 MW. Grade A- for operator page existence/capacity, B for operational status confirmation.

name: Start Campus SINES DC - SIN02 second building
notes: Second building of Sines 4.0 campus with ~200 MW capacity; Nscale investing ~EUR 465M in the 200 MW second building plus ~EUR 230M shared infrastructure under the Microsoft/Start Campus agreement (tek.sapo/Jan 2026); AICEP PortugalGlobal May 2026 confirms Microsoft Start Campus expansion plans; APA/SIAIA AIA 3633 + RECAPE 564 environmental files (Data Center Sines 4.0) cover phases. Construction advancing per Engexpor/idealista Jan 2026. 200 MW is planned phase capacity.

name: Voltekko Alcochete Data Center
notes: Eco-responsible AI/HPC data center announced for Alcochete (Setubal district, Lisbon metro). AICEP/PortugalGlobal May 2024 announcement; directories list Tier III+ design, 6.0 MW IT power capacity, target PUE <1.3. No construction or operation verified as of 2026-08-12 - keep announced.

name: Equinix Lisbon LS1 & LS2 IBX
notes: Two Equinix IBX facilities in Lisbon (LS1 at Av. Severiano Falcao 14, Prior Velho; LS2 launched June 2025 adjacent to LS1). LS1 hosts AWS Direct Connect location. Operator pages are A-grade for existence/location; no public MW. Equinix has announced plans for a third Lisbon data center by 2027 per DataCenterMap.

name: AtlasEdge Lisbon campus LIS001 / LIS002 / LIS003
notes: AtlasEdge Lisbon campus at Estrada Outurela 117a, Carnaxide (Oeiras, Grande Lisboa). LIS001 operational with 5.1 MW / 3,162 m2 data centre space, first customers installed; LIS002 in master planning (16 MW / 24 MVA, RFS 2028); LIS003 planned on adjacent 10,000 m2 plot; campus target up to 30 MW across three phases; EUR 253M green financing secured. Campus is in Lisbon district (Oeiras/Carnaxide).

name: MERLIN Edged Lisbon AI Campus (Vila Franca de Xira)
notes: 180 MW AI data centre campus in the Parque das Nacoes business district of Vila Franca de Xira (Lisbon district); construction broke ground Oct 2024; five data centers, waterless cooling, 100% solar; potential to scale toward 300 MW per SAPO TEK; Edged reports OCP Ready for hyperscale recognition. Operator release A- for existence/capacity; DCD confirms construction start.

name: AWS Lisbon Local Zone (AWS European Sovereign Cloud)
notes: AWS announced Lisbon, Portugal Local Zone (eusc-de-east-1-lis-1a) under the AWS European Sovereign Cloud Germany parent region; presented in Lisbon 20 April 2026 with the Portuguese government; estimated ~EUR 3bn GDP impact and 17,000+ jobs. Cloud edge/connectivity signal - not a full AWS Region; official region lists show no standard AWS/Azure/GCP/OCI Portugal public region.

name: IP Telecom Lisbon Data Center
notes: One of IP Telecom's 3 owned data centers (Lisbon, Porto, Viseu), ISO 27001 certified, 99.99% monthly availability, carrier-neutral housing/colo; part of national fibre backbone with 7 regional intervention centres. Operator page A for existence; no public MW.

name: IP Telecom Porto Data Center
notes: IP Telecom owned data center in Porto (one of 3 national DCs: Lisbon/Porto/Viseu); ISO 27001, 99.99% availability; operator page A for existence.

name: REN Ermesinde Data Center (RENTELECOM)
notes: Carrier-neutral data center at Rua das Agras Novas 46, Ermesinde (Porto district), run by REN's telecom unit; directory-listed 0.5 MW. C-grade directory evidence only; verify with REN/RENTELECOM before upgrading. NFSi Telecom Porto1 and FCCN Oporto also directory-listed in Porto (C).

name: Covilha Data Center Campus (Asterion / Altice Portugal / Portugal Telecom)
developer: Asterion Industrial Partners (acquired from Altice Portugal, EUR 120M)
notes: Covilha (Castelo Branco district; manifest label 'White Castle') data center campus built 2013 by Portugal Telecom; 6.8 MW installed capacity operational with modular expansion potential up to 75 MW within the campus and ~175 MW on adjacent power-secured land; Uptime Institute tier awards; Altice/MEO remains anchor customer. Asterion official release (A) for capacity; DCD (B) for acquisition.

name: EDC One 'EDC Port 1' data center at Pego (Abrantes)
notes: First datacenter project at the Pego power-station site (Abrantes, Santarem district): signed contract confirms 'EDC Port 1' as empresa de interesse municipal; local press cites EUR 7bn investment to install a data processing centre at Pego. Local press only (C/B) - verify with Camara de Abrantes minutes and PIP/licensing records.

name: Second Pego-area data center (200 MVA grid connection)
developer: Undisclosed (Hyperion II Renewables Services per industry leads)
notes: Abrantes municipality approved the prior information request (PIP) for a second data center adjacent to Pego, with 200 MVA grid connection to the future Posto de Corte de Abrantes and expected operation in 2029 (mediotejo, local press). 200 MVA is grid/import capacity, not IT MW. Methodology links Hyperion II Renewables Services to a 200 MVA Pego project; treat as approved at PIP stage.

name: FF Ventures Aljustrel Data Center (Mancoca Business & Logistics Park)
notes: Renewables developer FF Ventures signed a protocol with Aljustrel municipality (Beja district) to install a data center at Mancoca Business and Logistics Park, Rio de Moinhos parish; investment >EUR 200M, ~65 jobs; FF Ventures lists 310 MW of DC projects under development including 264 MW in Portugal. Protocol/announcement stage only; no construction verified.

name: RNCA/CNCA National Advanced Computing data center (Guimaraes, Univ. Minho Azurem campus)
developer: RNCA / FCCN with University of Minho / DST
notes: National Centre for Advanced Computing (RNCA) data center at Campus de Azurem, Av. da Universidade, Guimaraes (Braga district); public HPC facility supporting the national supercomputing network. DCD reported the project (B); DataCenterMap lists the facility (C). Not commercial colo - institutional HPC. Avoid double counting RNCA/CNCA/UMinho/DST aliases.

name: DECSIS Evora Data Center
developer: DECSIS - Sistemas de Informacao S.A. (with HP Portugal)
notes: DECSIS 'state of the art' data center in Evora built 2011 (company history; ~EUR 2M DECSIS/HP investment reported by Lusa via briefing.pt); operational hosting/colo services. Caveat: the Evora court declared DECSIS insolvent in Sept 2025 (eco.sapo.pt) - facility operating status as of 2026-08-12 unverified post-insolvency.

name: IP Telecom Viseu Data Center
notes: IP Telecom owned data center in Viseu (one of 3 national DCs); ISO 27001, 99.99% availability. AR Telecom also runs a Viseu colo facility at Av. Cap. Homem Ribeiro (directory C-lead).

name: Google Azores CLS - Lagoa (Nuvem/Sol cable landing & data infrastructure)
notes: Google cable landing station and data-infrastructure campus at Lot 32B, Tecnoparque da Lagoa, Lagoa municipality, Sao Miguel island; ~10 MW / 15,000 m2 per industry sources; houses Google's private Nuvem and Sol transatlantic cables (Nuvem announced 2023, SubCom supplier). Not a GCP region and not commercial colo - cable landing/data infrastructure. C-grade directory for capacity; methodology flags Google Azores as high-value lead.

name: NOS Ponta Delgada Data Center
notes: NOS inaugurated the Ponta Delgada (Sao Miguel, Azores) data center on 19 Sept 2019, adding ~260 m2 of technical/server room area in the archipelago (NOS official release A; Business-IT B). Regional operator DC supporting cloud/enterprise services; NOS total portfolio was 7 DCs / 3,800 m2 at the time.

name: NOS Madeira Data Center (Funchal)
notes: NOS Madeira data center inaugurated 29 July 2021 at Rua EUA 51, Nazare - Sao Martinho, Funchal; developed by EMACOM (owned by Empresa de Electricidade da Madeira); regional operator DC. Funchal Noticias local press (B).

name: EMACOM Madeira data center (Virtudes)
developer: EMACOM / EEM (Empresa de Electricidade da Madeira)
notes: EMACOM (EEM subsidiary) planned ~EUR 9M investment in the largest data centre in Madeira at Virtudes, targeted 2024 (Diario de Noticias Madeira, Nov 2021). Status as of 2026-08-12 not re-confirmed - treat as announced/planned unless a newer source confirms operation.

name: CIMAA Centro de Dados Informatico do Alto Alentejo
developer: CIMAA - Comunidade Intermunicipal do Alto Alentejo
notes: Inter-municipal community CIMAA (Alto Alentejo, HQ Portalegre) creating a regional shared-services data centre ('Centro de Dados Informatico') for 11 member municipalities; ~EUR 3M invested; supports computing/communications infrastructure and smart-territory projects. Public-sector shared services, not commercial colo; local news only (C).

name: CTS Group / NordicEPOD production campus (Viana do Castelo)
developer: CTS Group (Norway) with Eaton - NordicEPOD JV
notes: CTS Group (Nordic data centre design/build leader) with Eaton is building its largest production campus in Viana do Castelo: a EUR 50M factory producing EPOD power-distribution units for data centres, ~500 jobs, ~450 EPODs/year; construction started (Feb 2025 announcement; June 2026 construction report). This is datacenter supply-chain/manufacturing infrastructure, not an operating DC - recorded for division completeness.

name: AIBILI Clinical Data Centre (Coimbra)
developer: AIBILI - Association for Innovation and Biomedical Research on Light and Image
notes: AIBILI data centre in Coimbra holds ECRIN-ERIC Data Centre Certification (renewed), providing certified clinical-trial data management and electronic data capture. Institutional/clinical-research data centre, not commercial colo.
